description: Presas de abastecimiento de agua de titularidad de la Junta de Extremadura is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Extremadura. List of water supply dams managed by the Junta de Extremadura. Surface area, capacity and level at Maximum Normal Level (NMN). UMT30-ETRS89 coordinates. Coverage: Junta de Extremadura. The portal shows the English title as "Water supply dams owned by the Government of Extremadura" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Junta de Extremadura. The listing shows 2023-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
